# Nested list boundaries

The outline below contains several levels of real list structure. A safe list indentation repair must preserve each parent-child relationship, each marker, and the short explanations attached to them. The prose deliberately includes Unicode identifiers such as 子項目 and café while keeping every line short enough to avoid unrelated wrapping behavior.

- delivery

    - signed archive
  - Windows
    - installer
- verification
